purpose: MealNova India nutrition repair queue for high-priority foods
important_note: This file intentionally does not invent replacement nutrition values. It identifies the first 250 records to validate and defines the repair/QA contract.

accuracy_definition.food_name_recognition: Measure top-1 canonical dish identification separately from calorie/macros.
accuracy_definition.calories: Do not define 95% accuracy as exact numeric equality. Use tolerance bands; highly variable mixed dishes require ranges and confidence.
accuracy_definition.macros: Score protein, carbs, and fat separately and only against recipe/portion-grounded benchmark cases.

authoritative_sources.name: ICMR-NIN Indian Food Composition Tables 2017
authoritative_sources.caution: mostly raw-food analytical data; do not treat as direct cooked mixed-dish values

authoritative_sources.name: standardized recipe calculation
authoritative_sources.role: primary method for mixed Indian dishes
authoritative_sources.method: sum ingredient nutrients, account for edible yield/cooking yield, normalize to final cooked weight, record range for oil/sugar/portion variability

authoritative_sources.name: restaurant/manufacturer nutrition
authoritative_sources.role: exact branded/restaurant dish only; not generic dish truth

repair_pipeline: assign standard recipe and cooking yield

promotion_gate.nutrition_value_requires: at least 2 independent evidence paths for high-variability dishes; 1 authoritative composition source may suffice for simple foods
